about.title: About
about.p1: I'm a frontend developer who enjoys the part of the job between design and code: turning a layout into something that responds well to touch, to a keyboard and to a bad connection.
about.p2: I work mostly with React, Next.js and TypeScript, and I care about accessibility, performance and code that still reads well six months from now.
